title: Vent BOX Ductless Filtration System
meta_title: Vent BOX Ductless Filtration System - Protect Lab Personnel from Chemical Vapors
meta_description: The Air Science Vent BOX ductless filtration system is a modular ventilation and filtration unit designed to protect laboratory personnel from chemical vapors found inside stand-alone safety cabinets.
meta_keywords: vent box, ductless filtration, laboratory safety, chemical vapor protection, modular ventilation
short_description: Air Science Vent BOX ductless filtration systems are modular ventilation and filtration units designed to protect laboratory personnel from chemical vapors found inside of stand-alone chemical safety cabinets.
full_description: The Vent BOX creates a safe work environment over the widest range of applications in the industry, including flammable materials, acid and corrosive chemicals, paints, pesticides, and other hazardous materials. With its low-profile, completely portable, and ductless design, the Vent BOX can be easily positioned on shallow safety cabinets without requiring any additional ductwork. The modular design permits multiple configurations, and the universal connections allow retrofit to almost all available flammable and safety cabinets on the market.
seo_content: Featuring innovative filtration technology, the Vent BOX provides comprehensive protection for laboratory personnel working with a variety of hazardous materials. Its compact size and modular design make it a versatile solution for a wide range of applications, from chemical storage to paint and pesticide handling. With compliance to key industry standards, the Vent BOX ensures a safe and compliant work environment for your laboratory.

Protection & Compliance.OSHA: OSHA Standard -29 CFR, Safety and Health Regulations for General Industry, 1910.1450: Occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories. Part B, definition, laboratory type hood. Please consult your Safety Officer and/or Industrial Hygienist.
